heroHeadline: Rights Lawyer Thelma Montenegro Held Incommunicado in Suspected Enforced Disappearance as Rights Groups Demand Release
heroSubtitle: Detained twice within a week and transferred to Managua without notice to her family, Montenegro's case underscores an intensifying crackdown as Murillo brands the Chamorro family 'traitors' in the National Assembly and the OAS foreign ministers' session on Nicaragua remains undated ahead of September's constitutional vote
